reason: We have no car right now, so getting to Spinneys or Tawfeer in Jbeil is a real problem for me. A bag waiting in the village for $2 on top of till prices is cheaper than paying someone to drive me, so I would try it for dry goods and packs.
objection: I want to choose my own vegetables and meat, and I would be trusting a stranger to pick them. I also do not know how I can check that the price I pay is really what was on the till.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the till receipt with my bag, and a promise that I can refuse or get credit for bad vegetables or meat.
